correctness.rationale: Over the actual integral lattice, each active zero off-diagonal inequality contributes a unit row. Deleting them leaves independent unsigned incidence matrices of positive-support K2 and odd cycles. Integral Smith reduction gives one Z per K2 and one Z/2 per odd cycle. For canonical Cartier equations, all inactive off-support edges are assigned 1; K2 edge coordinates are -(n-1) and odd-cycle coordinates are -(n-2)/2, proving the parity condition. The exponential formula counts undirected odd cycles with (l-1)!/2 labeled structures. An independent exact enumeration of all vertex supports n=3..6 verified Smith normal forms and Cartier indices; independent exact linear-program vertex enumeration verifies n=3,4. Full theorem is symbolic, not an inference from checks.

value.rationale: The result determines a natural local geometric invariant and its canonical index simultaneously at every torus fixed chart of an infinite family. It distinguishes integral free class-group obstructions from 2-torsion defects associated with different support blocks, and supplies a complete bivariate enumeration. These data cannot be read directly from known vertex counts or Ehrhart coefficients, and inform the geometry of Gorenstein and Q-factorial fixed charts.
